help.title: How to Use Excel Consolidation Report Mapper
help.whatItDoesText: This application converts consolidated transaction reports (Excel files) into properly formatted poliza ledger files. It automatically maps and transforms your data according to predefined template logic.
help.selectFileText: Click "Choose File" or drag and drop your Excel file (.xlsx or .xls format) into the upload area.
help.processFileText: Click "Process File" and wait for the transformation to complete. You'll see a progress indicator.
help.downloadResultsText: Once complete, download your processed poliza ledger file and review the transformation summary.
help.headerRowText: Your Excel file should have column headers on row 27 with names like "System", "Lease Area", "Business Unit", etc.
help.dataRowsText: Your transaction data should begin on row 28 and continue downward
help.formatText: The application expects this specific structure to properly process your consolidated transaction report
help.noDataText: Ensure your file has headers on row 27 and data starting from row 28. The application expects this specific structure.
help.invalidFormatText: Ensure your file is a proper Excel format (.xlsx or .xls) and not corrupted.
help.processingFailedText: Your data might not match the expected format. Verify that your consolidated report follows the standard structure with headers on row 27.
help.exampleText: If your Excel file looks like this:
help.exampleRow27: Row 27: System | Lease Area | Business Unit | Lease Department
help.structureRecognizedText: Headers on row 27, data from row 28 onward
help.needMoreHelpText: If you continue experiencing issues, please check that your Excel file follows the expected consolidated transaction report format with proper headers and data structure.
